title: git.repo.test: cap jest workers at 4 by default, so groves fit more crews
description:
## .what

git.repo.test caps jest workers at 4 by default (`--maxWorkers=4`), with a flag to override (e.g. `--workers <n|N%>`).

## .why

a grove is a shared box: its cores buy room for MORE crews, never a faster crew. jest defaults to cores-1, so on a 36-core grove one suite claims 35 workers and the box fits one crew instead of ~9. a cap of 4 is free on ci runners and laptops (mostly <=4 cores), and is what lets crews sit side by side on a grove.

measured 2026-11-18 on a 36-core hetzner grove: the svc-chat integration suite ran at 35 workers, and all 29 files started inside one second.

## .done when

- the default run passes `--maxWorkers=4` to jest for unit and integration
- an override flag exists, documented in --help
- a test pins the default
